prompt.text:
This is an isolated Native Turn recovery experiment.
Do not read, list, inspect, search, browse, or access the network.
Call the bash tool exactly once with exactly this command and no wrapper:
printf '%s\n' 'ROVAI_P1_IN_FLIGHT_KILL_1_a263089120e5474a97a609770e618d4e' >> p1-nonce.txt && sleep 30
After the command returns, reply with exactly P1_DONE_ROVAI_P1_IN_FLIGHT_KILL_1_a263089120e5474a97a609770e618d4e and nothing else.
Do not call any other tool.

availableCommands.name: feishu-docs
availableCommands.description: 读取、分析并按 Block 更新飞书(Lark)云文档与多维表格数据。当需要:(1) 获取飞书文档/知识库的富文本内容和 Block 结构(2) 更新新版文档中的指定文本 Block (3) 查询多维表格(Bitable)记录,支持过滤和分页(4) 提取飞书协作空间的结构化数据用于分析使用此 Skill。支持文档 Block 递归解析、Block 级文本更新、表格字段类型映射、批量数据导出。关键词: 飞书、Lark、云文档、多维表格、Bitable、开放平台 API

clientInfo.name: rovai_p1_experiment
clientInfo.title: Rovai P1 Native Turn Reconciliation Experiment

content.text:
This is an isolated Native Turn recovery experiment.
Do not read, list, inspect, search, browse, or access the network.
Call the bash tool exactly once with exactly this command and no wrapper:
printf '%s\n' 'ROVAI_P1_IN_FLIGHT_KILL_1_a263089120e5474a97a609770e618d4e' >> p1-nonce.txt && sleep 30
After the command returns, reply with exactly P1_DONE_ROVAI_P1_IN_FLIGHT_KILL_1_a263089120e5474a97a609770e618d4e and nothing else.
Do not call any other tool.
